models.name: discussion_board_guests
models.description:
Guest accounts for unauthenticated visitors identified by device fingerprint for temporary session tracking.

Guests represent anonymous users who browse the discussion board without traditional authentication. Each guest is identified by a unique device fingerprint, enabling temporary session management and basic tracking without requiring email/password credentials. Guests have read-only access to sections, articles, and comments but cannot create content or manage profiles.

Related to {@link discussion_board_guest_sessions} through one-to-many relationship where each guest can have multiple sessions over time.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Unique device fingerprint identifier for guest tracking. Generated from browser/device characteristics to distinguish anonymous visitors without requiring authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was first created. Used for tracking guest lifecycle and session management.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated. Updated on each session activity for tracking purposes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was soft deleted. Null for active records. Enables data retention and audit trail while removing guest from active queries.

models.name: discussion_board_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest users with expiration for anonymous browsing access.

Tracks guest user sessions for stateless authentication during anonymous browsing. Each session represents a single browsing session with connection metadata and expiration time for automatic cleanup. Sessions are created when guests access the platform and expire after the configured duration.

Related to {@link discussion_board_guests} through many-to-one relationship (multiple sessions per guest).

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged guest's {@link discussion_board_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security audit.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Initial page URL where the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header indicating traffic source.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for automatic invalidation.

models.name: discussion_board_members
models.description: Registered member accounts with email and password authentication. Stores profile information including display name shown publicly and biography text. Tracks account status for lifecycle management including active, suspended, and deleted states. Members can create articles, post comments, and request administrator status.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for authentication and account identification. Must be unique across all member accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password credential for authentication. Never stores plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Public display name shown on articles, comments, and profile pages. Visible to all users including guests.

plainFields.name: bio
plainFields.description: Biography text for member profile. Optional personal description visible on profile page.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status for lifecycle management. Values: active, suspended, deleted. Controls login ability and content visibility.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created. Immutable after initial registration.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated. Updated on every profile or credential change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was soft deleted. Null for active accounts. Enables account deletion cascade.

models.name: discussion_board_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh token support.

Stores active and expired session records for registered members. Each session represents a distinct login event with connection metadata for security auditing. Sessions are managed through authentication flows and serve as an append-only audit trail of member login activity.

Related to {@link discussion_board_members} through many-to-one relationship. Multiple sessions can exist per member for concurrent device access.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client device at session creation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where authentication was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value at session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for automatic invalidation.

models.name: discussion_board_member_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for member password recovery workflow. Stores temporary tokens with expiration timestamps that members use to reset their forgotten passwords. Each token is single-use and becomes invalid after expiration or use.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to member's email for verification.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp when the reset token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was used, null if not yet used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

models.name: discussion_board_member_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for member registration and email confirmation process. Stores one-time verification tokens with expiration to validate email addresses during account creation and email changes. Each token is unique and can only be used once before expiration.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address being verified. Stored for validation even if member email changes during verification process.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent to the email address. Used for one-time email confirmation.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Verification fails after this time to prevent stale token usage.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Null if not yet verified or expired.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

models.name: discussion_board_admins
models.description: Administrator accounts with elevated privileges for platform governance and content moderation. Administrators are promoted from regular members through an approval process and have two grade levels: regular administrators can manage sections, delete content, and ban users; super administrators have additional powers to approve admin requests and manage other administrators' grades. Each admin record maintains a 1:1 relationship with a member account, preserving the member's original identity while granting elevated permissions.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}. Administrator accounts are promoted from existing members, maintaining a 1:1 relationship with the original member account.

plainFields.name: grade
plainFields.description: Administrator grade level determining privilege scope. 'regular' administrators can manage sections, delete content, and ban users. 'super' administrators have elevated powers including approving admin requests and managing other administrators' grades.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created (when the admin request was approved).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator record was last updated, such as grade changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator privileges were revoked (soft delete). Null means active administrator.

plainIndexes.description: Composite index for filtering administrators by grade and sorting by creation date.

models.name: discussion_board_admin_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for administrator authentication with enhanced security. Tracks login sessions including connection metadata (IP address, referrer, href) and temporal fields for audit compliance. Sessions are append-only records managed through the authentication flow, providing an audit trail of all administrator access events.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged administrator's {@link discussion_board_admins.id}. Establishes the session's association with the administrator account.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the administrator's connection at session creation. Used for security monitoring and audit trail.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where the administrator initiated the login. Provides context for the authentication event.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header from the login request. Tracks the navigation path leading to authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created. Marks the beginning of the session's validity period.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Sessions are invalid after this time and must be refreshed or re-authenticated.

models.name: discussion_board_admin_audit_logs
models.description:
Audit trail logging all administrator actions including bans, content deletion, section management, and admin request decisions. Provides compliance tracking and administrative transparency for all elevated privilege operations.

Each record captures a single administrative action with the acting administrator, action type, target entity, and contextual details. This table is append-only and serves as the authoritative audit log for regulatory compliance and security investigations.

Related to {@link discussion_board_admins} through the admin foreign key relationship.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Acting administrator's {@link discussion_board_admins.id} who performed the audited action.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of administrative action performed. Examples: ban, unban, delete_article, delete_comment, create_section, edit_section, delete_section, approve_admin_request, reject_admin_request, promote_admin, demote_admin.

plainFields.name: target_entity
plainFields.description: Type of entity affected by the action. Examples: user, article, comment, section, admin_request.

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: ID of the affected entity. Nullable for actions that don't target a specific entity.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: JSON string containing additional context about the action. May include ban reasons, rejection reasons, or other action-specific metadata.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the administrator at the time of action for security auditing.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Browser/client user agent string for security auditing and forensic analysis.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrative action was performed.

models.name: discussion_board_sections
models.description:
Discussion board sections for topic organization with name and description.

Sections categorize articles into topic areas (e.g., Politics, Economy, Current Affairs). Administrators create and manage sections, while all users can browse sections and view articles within them. Each section has a unique name and descriptive text explaining its purpose.

Sections are referenced by {@link discussion_board_articles} through the section foreign key relationship.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Section name for topic categorization. Must be unique across all sections.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Section description explaining the topic scope and purpose.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was soft deleted. Null if section is active.

models.name: discussion_board_section_snapshots
models.description: Point-in-time snapshots of sections for audit trail and change tracking. Captures the state of a section at specific moments to preserve historical data for compliance, moderation review, and change tracking. Each snapshot is immutable and append-only, creating a complete history of section modifications over time.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_section_id
foreignFields.description: Parent section's {@link discussion_board_sections.id}. References the section this snapshot belongs to.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Section name at the time of snapshot. Denormalized from parent section to preserve historical value.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Section description at the time of snapshot. Denormalized from parent section to preserve historical value.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created. Records the point-in-time when the section state was captured.

models.name: discussion_board_articles
models.description: Main article entity representing user-created content in the discussion board. Each article belongs to exactly one section and is authored by one member. Articles support multiple file attachments, image attachments, and tags through separate child tables. Articles can be edited and deleted by their authors, and administrators can delete any article for moderation. Soft delete is supported via deleted_at timestamp for cascade deletion tracking and audit purposes.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_section_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged section's {@link discussion_board_sections.id}. Articles must be assigned to exactly one section for topic organization.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Author member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}. The registered user who created and owns this article.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title. Required field that serves as the main heading and primary search target for article discovery.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Article body content text. Required field containing the main discussion content, supports rich text formatting.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Article creation timestamp. Records when the article was first created, used for chronological sorting and audit trail.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Article last update timestamp. Records when the article was last modified, updated on each edit operation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Article soft deletion timestamp. Null for active articles, populated when article is deleted to enable cascade deletion tracking and audit compliance.

models.name: discussion_board_article_files
models.description: File attachments for articles, supporting multiple files per article with storage metadata. Each file record tracks the original filename, MIME type, file size, and storage location. Files are managed through their parent article and cascade delete when the article is removed. Separate from image attachments to support different validation rules and processing workflows.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article's {@link discussion_board_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who uploaded the file's {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Stored filename in the storage system, typically a UUID or hash to ensure uniqueness.

plainFields.name: original_name
plainFields.description: Original filename as uploaded by the user, preserved for display and download purposes.

plainFields.name: mime_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., application/pdf, text/plain) for content type validation and proper download headers.

plainFields.name: size
plainFields.description: File size in bytes for storage quota management and upload validation.

plainFields.name: path
plainFields.description: Storage path or URL where the file is located, used for file retrieval and CDN access.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the file attachment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the file attachment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the file attachment was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: discussion_board_article_images
models.description: Image attachments for articles storing image-specific metadata including dimensions, file size, and storage location. Each record represents one image file attached to an article, supporting multiple images per article. Images are managed through the parent article and cascade deleted when the article is removed.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article's {@link discussion_board_articles.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Original filename of the uploaded image.

plainFields.name: size
plainFields.description: File size in bytes.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the image file (e.g., image/jpeg, image/png).

plainFields.name: url
plainFields.description: CDN or storage URL for accessing the image file.

plainFields.name: width
plainFields.description: Image width in pixels.

plainFields.name: height
plainFields.description: Image height in pixels.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image attachment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image attachment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image attachment was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: discussion_board_tags
models.description:
Reusable tag definitions for article categorization and discovery. Tags are created on-demand when users add them to articles and can be reused across multiple articles. Enables efficient tag-based filtering, search, and content discovery workflows.

Tags support the article tagging system where users can attach multiple free-text tags to their articles for better organization and discoverability. Each unique tag name is stored once and referenced by multiple articles through the discussion_board_article_tags junction table.

Related entities: {@link discussion_board_articles} (tagged articles), {@link discussion_board_article_tags} (many-to-many junction).

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Tag name text for article categorization. Must be unique across all tags to enable tag reuse and prevent duplication. Used for tag-based filtering and search functionality.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was first created. Automatically set on tag creation for audit trail and chronological tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was last modified. Updated on each tag modification to track change history.

models.name: discussion_board_article_tags
models.description: Junction table establishing many-to-many relationship between articles and tags. Enables efficient tag-based article filtering and tag reuse across multiple articles. Each row represents a single tag assignment to an article, with uniqueness constraint preventing duplicate tag assignments on the same article.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the article being tagged. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_tag_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the tag being applied. {@link discussion_board_tags.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was assigned to the article. Used for tracking tag assignment order and audit purposes.

models.name: discussion_board_article_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time snapshots of article content for audit trail and change tracking.

Captures the state of an article at specific moments, preserving title and body content as they existed at each snapshot. Created automatically when articles are created or modified to maintain a complete audit trail.

Used for compliance requirements, content moderation review, and tracking content changes over time. Each snapshot is immutable once created.

Related to {@link discussion_board_articles} through a one-to-many relationship where one article can have multiple snapshots over its lifetime.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article's {@link discussion_board_articles.id}. References the article this snapshot belongs to.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title at the time of snapshot. Denormalized from the parent article for historical preservation.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Article content at the time of snapshot. Denormalized from the parent article for historical preservation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created. Represents the point-in-time when the article state was captured.

models.name: discussion_board_comments
models.description: Single-level comments on articles enabling discussion threads. Each comment belongs to exactly one article and is authored by one member. Comments are displayed in chronological order (oldest first) and support edit/delete operations by owners and administrators. Cascade deletion occurs when parent articles are deleted.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article's {@link discussion_board_articles.id}. Comments cannot exist without an article.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Author member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}. Only registered members can post comments.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Comment text content. Required field with minimum and maximum length constraints per validation rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was initially created. Used for chronological sorting (oldest first).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was last modified. Updated on each edit operation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was soft deleted. Null indicates active comment. Set on owner deletion, admin deletion, or cascade from article deletion.

models.name: discussion_board_comment_snapshots
models.description: Point-in-time snapshots of comments for audit trail. Captures comment state at each edit to preserve edit history and enable content moderation review. Each snapshot record is immutable and append-only, creating a complete historical record of comment modifications.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Parent comment's {@link discussion_board_comments.id}. References the comment this snapshot belongs to.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Author member's {@link discussion_board_members.id} at snapshot time. Denormalized for historical accuracy.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article's {@link discussion_board_articles.id} at snapshot time. Denormalized for historical accuracy.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Comment content at snapshot time. Preserves the exact text as it appeared when this snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created. Records the exact moment of the edit or state capture.

models.name: discussion_board_admin_requests
models.description:
Administrator application requests submitted by members seeking privilege escalation. Each request includes justification reason, current status (pending/approved/rejected), and submission timestamp. Super administrators review and decide on requests, with decision recorded for audit trail.

Key relationships:
- {@link discussion_board_members}: The member who submitted the request
- {@link discussion_board_admins}: The super administrator who made the decision (nullable until decided)
- {@link discussion_board_admin_request_histories}: Audit trail of all status transitions

Business constraints:
- Single pending request per member (enforced by unique index on member_id with status filter at application layer)
- Status transitions: pending → approved/rejected (immutable after decision)
- Reason text required (50-2000 characters per validation rules)

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: The member who submitted the administrator application request. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: The super administrator who reviewed and decided on this request. {@link discussion_board_admins.id}

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Justification text explaining why the member requests administrator privileges. Required field with 50-2000 character validation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current request status: pending (awaiting review), approved (promoted to administrator), or rejected (denied). Transitions from pending to approved/rejected are immutable.

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member submitted the administrator request. Used for sorting pending queue and enforcing waiting periods.

plainFields.name: decided_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the super administrator made the decision (approved/rejected). Null while status is pending.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit trail.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp for change tracking.

models.name: discussion_board_admin_request_histories
models.description:
Audit trail recording all status transitions of administrator application requests. Each history entry captures when a request's status changed, which super administrator made the decision, and the reason for rejection if applicable. This table provides complete audit compliance for privilege escalation workflows and administrative transparency.

Related entities: {@link discussion_board_admin_requests} (parent request being audited), {@link discussion_board_admins} (super administrator who made the decision).

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_admin_request_id
foreignFields.description: Parent admin request's {@link discussion_board_admin_requests.id} being audited.

foreignFields.name: deciding_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Super administrator's {@link discussion_board_admins.id} who made the status decision.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Request status at this transition point. Values: pending, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional reason text for rejection decisions. Null for approvals or pending status.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status transition occurred.

models.name: discussion_board_bans
models.description:
Active ban records that restrict user access to the platform.

Stores current bans imposed by administrators on members, including the ban reason and timestamp. Each banned user has exactly one active ban record at any time. When a user is unbanned, the record is soft-deleted and an entry is added to the ban history audit trail.

Banned users cannot log in but their existing articles and comments remain visible per content preservation policy. Administrators can view the banned users list with ban reasons for transparency.

Related entities: {@link discussion_board_members} (banned user), {@link discussion_board_admins} (enforcing administrator), {@link discussion_board_ban_histories} (audit trail).

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Banned member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}. The user whose access is restricted by this ban.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Enforcing administrator's {@link discussion_board_admins.id}. The administrator who imposed this ban.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Ban reason explaining why the user was banned. Required for administrative transparency and must meet minimum/maximum length validation requirements.

plainFields.name: banned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the ban was imposed. Automatically recorded at ban creation and immutable thereafter for audit integrity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Set when user is unbanned to preserve audit history while marking ban as inactive.

models.name: discussion_board_ban_histories
models.description:
Audit trail of all ban and unban events with timestamps and action-specific reasons.

This table maintains a complete history of all ban-related actions for compliance and transparency. Each record captures either a ban or unban event, including the action type and reason provided by the administrator at the time of the action.

Related to {@link discussion_board_bans} for the parent ban record (which contains member and administrator references), {@link discussion_board_members} for the affected user account (via ban relationship), and {@link discussion_board_admins} for the administrator who performed the action (via ban relationship).

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_ban_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent ban record. {@link discussion_board_bans.id}. Member and administrator references are accessible through this relationship.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Type of action performed: 'banned' or 'unbanned'. Distinguishes between ban imposition and ban removal events.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Action-specific reason provided by the administrator. Required for ban events, optional for unban events. Captures the context for this specific history entry.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the ban or unban action was recorded. Immutable after creation for audit integrity.
